changelog:
1.7.7 - Multiplayer Thread Safety
  FIXED: Critical inputQueue race condition between UI thread and game thread
  FIXED: Client no longer gets stuck in cinematic/upgrade when host disconnects
  FIXED: Host no longer gets stuck in MP_PLAYING when client disconnects
  FIXED: hostItemRects race condition (rebuild per-frame instead of mutating shared list)
  FIXED: Added volatile to cross-thread fields (clientColor, clientBodyColor, mpModeSel, mpBoardCols, etc.)
  FIXED: Manual IP connect failure now shows retry hint; cancel restarts discovery
